video_title: Peter Schrager is taking Jalen Brunson as the BEST PLAYER IN THE NBA 😳 | Big Day

quotes.speaker: Peter Schrager
quotes.summary_phrase: Peter Schrager ranks Jalen Brunson as the NBA's top player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson to me is the number one player in the NBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Peter Schrager
text_blocks.text: I have the host of SNL as the number one player in the NBA. The question is, who do you want in the biggest moments, who would you build your team around? I want Jalen Brunson. I go Jokic number two, I go SGA, Wemby before Anthony Edwards five. I watched him go up against Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, obviously that entire Sixers team, and then I saw him go up to Wemby and Castle and the rest and obviously dominate. Jalen Brunson to me is the number one player in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Jason McCourty
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason McCourty ranks Victor Wembanyama as the NBA's top player
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama, and this is just a forecast of where things are to come.
quotes.quote: I am starting with Wemby. Victor Wembanyama, and this is just a forecast of where things are to come. We saw what he did this year, how he got his team to the finals. Wemby number one. Number two, no-brainer, SGA. This guy is just a bonafide basketball player. I have Jokic at number three, slow-mo guy that figures it out, gets it done on the court. I have respect for Jalen Brunson, I have him at number four. This was a struggle for me. I went back and forth with Anthony Edwards and Luka Doncic. Luka has been to a finals, he has done a ton. I think he is still getting over the hump to get back there, but that is why I went with Luka number five.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst defends Jalen Brunson's ranking as a top player
quotes.excerpt: If you are not putting Brunson number one right now, he is riding the wave.
quotes.quote: If you are not putting Brunson number one right now, he is riding the wave. He is the finals MVP. Hell, yeah, put him one. Don't defend it, just say it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst evaluates Luka Doncic's physical condition
quotes.excerpt: Luka looks like he is 19 years old weight.
quotes.quote: I don't know if you have seen Luka this summer. You thought Luka was skinny last year. Luka looks like he is 19 years old weight. We will see when he comes to camp next week. Luka looks like he is in great shape.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst questions the omission of Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I still think Giannis is a force at both ends, he has got to be on the court.
quotes.quote: I find it interesting that neither of you guys had Giannis in there. I know that Giannis has had injuries the last couple years. I am not even saying I 100% disagree, but I still think Giannis is a force at both ends, he has got to be on the court. I just love the idea of having a two-way player, and I totally think that is why you got to have Victor on both lists.

quotes.speaker: Steven Adams
quotes.summary_phrase: Steven Adams predicts a performance dip due to GTA release
quotes.excerpt: You guys should anticipate November. The performance of the league, league wide. GTA is dropping.
quotes.quote: You guys should anticipate November. The performance of the league, league wide. GTA is dropping. So look at NFL, look at all the leagues and watch them plummet, mate. Just for the month of November, performance is going to go down. It should come back up though, most of the boys will get it done, but hopefully they finish game. Coaching as well, by the way. The coaching scouts are going to be horrendous, mate. Just for November, but it should bounce back in December, hopefully.

quotes.speaker: Jason McCourty
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason McCourty discusses how Fortnite impacted locker room focus
quotes.excerpt: I was no longer into video games, and it was this game called Fortnite.
quotes.quote: I feel like when I became unk in the locker room when I was an old guy, wife and kids, I was no longer into video games, and it was this game called Fortnite that came out. We would have young guys coming to the locker room, and all they would talk about was playing Fortnite. They couldn't wait to get home and play Fortnite. But then they would come in the very next day and get questioned in the team meeting room about their assignment on kickoff, punt, offense, defense, and they wouldn't know what the hell they were doing, but they were up all night playing Fortnite.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Brandt
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Brandt shares his experience with Legend of Zelda
quotes.excerpt: I almost failed out of college because of a little game called The Legend of Zelda.
quotes.quote: I almost failed out of college because of a little game called The Legend of Zelda, the Ocarina of Time. I have some of the world's most prestigious professors ready to teach me and I am like, no, I got to get the magic shield and beat the water temple. I was a fiend. I felt like I lived there. You are at Princeton, John Nash is teaching you, and I am going, and then the opponent comes running out. Let's go baby, I got the white sword.
